hook_text: Bus leaves at 06:50, arrives at 10:35. Subtract and you get 385. That is not the answer. Here is why.
clip_script: Polokwane to Johannesburg. Departs 06:50, arrives 10:35. Subtract them like normal numbers? 1035 minus 650 is 385. Nonsense, an hour has 60 minutes, not 100. Count on instead. 06:50 to 07:00: 10 minutes. 07:00 to 10:00: 3 hours. 10:00 to 10:35: 35 minutes. Add the jumps: 3 hours 45 minutes. Add a 25 minute lunch stop: 45 plus 25 is 70 minutes, which is 1 hour 10 minutes. Total: 4 hours 10 minutes. And the chain to remember: 60 seconds, 60 minutes, 24 hours, 7 days, 12 months, 10 years in a decade.
visual_style: Whiteboard number line from 06:50 to 10:35 with three jump arcs; a bus moving along the road; 70 minutes regrouping into 1 hour 10 minutes.
pacing: The subtraction trap, three clean jumps, the lunch stop, then the unit chain.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and time how long your trip to school takes, start to finish.
